summary: Iteration 14: Validated EasyBillsPay refactor (models/schemas.py, utils/auth.py) + v2 tier-gating + Resend live. Backend pytest: 14/14 PASS (incl. /api/auth/register now FIXED — was the critical 500 from iter13). Tier-gating verified: Basic user receives 403 with upgrade message on all 4 v2 endpoints (predict-bills, simulate-plan, plan-health, savings-comparison); Standard user gets 200 with full data; unauthenticated returns 401/403. Frontend E2E (Playwright): Standard customer login → /dashboard with bills+wallet $500+AI insight; Annual Plan renders full forecast ($5657.89/yr, $509.21/mo smoothed, Peak Jul 2026, $91.04 variance, chart, savings 93→100%, category breakdown) ✓; Bill Intelligence loads ✓; Subscription page shows 3 tiers (Basic Free / Standard $9.90 'Current Plan' / Premium $19.90) with Select buttons ✓; Basic user lands on /dashboard and Annual Plan correctly displays blue 'Upgrade to Unlock Forecasting' card with data-testid='forecast-upgrade' (4 console 403s confirm tier-gating fires) ✓; Admin login NOW auto-redirects to /admin (fixed from iter13) and Financial Overview renders real data (6 users, 7 pending bills, $1010.95 outstanding, Outstanding-by-Period chart, Money Flow donut) ✓.

minor.issue: Still no health endpoint (carry-over from iter13, low priority).

issues: Initial render shows 3 empty skeleton placeholders for ~5-7s while /api/v2/subscription/tiers loads — no spinner/loading text. Cards populate correctly afterwards. Consider adding a 'Loading plans…' indicator or shimmer inside skeletons for better UX.

action_items: Optional UX: add loading indicator on Subscription page skeletons (currently looks like a broken page on slow networks).
Optional: add GET /api/health endpoint for monitoring (carry-over).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 2859 lines — exceeds the 700-line threshold. Refactor extracted models + utils helped, but route handlers should be split into routers/ (e.g., routes/auth.py, routes/bills.py, routes/v2.py).
_get_user_tier() falls back to SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS['basic'] silently — fine, but log a warning when an unknown tier_id is encountered for observability.
utils/auth.py: passlib bcrypt warning persists (bcrypt>=4 incompatibility). Pin bcrypt<4 in requirements.txt or upgrade passlib.
utils/auth.py: `jwt.JWTError` may not exist on PyJWT >=2 (it's `jwt.PyJWTError`); double-check exception class to avoid masking unexpected errors.
RESEND import is at module load (line 82) gated by RESEND_API_KEY — okay, but `resend` is a hard dependency at runtime when key is set; add it to requirements.txt explicitly and document.
Subscription tier check could be cached per-request (currently does a sdb.find_one on every v2 call) — minor perf optimization.
